category_title: Students who use defensive social put-downs when challenged
scenario_title: Salinity investigation and explaining mass differences
minimal_context: The student is participating in a small-group discussion to predict which cup of water will make an egg float and explain the mass differences between the cups.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have two cups of water and an egg. Which cup do you predict will make the egg float?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I think that this one because of the salt water, it will hold the egg up.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at the cups on the scale. What do you observe?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This has two things: salt and water. And that one has just one thing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Notice that both cups have equal volume, but different weights. Why do you think that is?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: That’s because it has an extra thing. It makes it heavier.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We have two cups of water and an egg. Which cup do you predict will make the egg float?

STUDENT: I think that this one because of the salt water, it will hold the egg up.

TUTOR: Let's look at the cups on the scale. What do you observe?

STUDENT: This has two things: salt and water. And that one has just one thing.

TUTOR: Notice that both cups have equal volume, but different weights. Why do you think that is?

STUDENT: That’s because it has an extra thing. It makes it heavier.

task.content: Salinity investigation using two cups of water and an egg; students are making predictions about which cup will make the egg float.
task.learning_goal: explaining why the cup with salt water weighs more than the cup with fresh water

context.materials: two cups of water and an egg, scale

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: explaining why the cup with salt water weighs more than the cup with fresh water after weighing them on a scale.
related_quotes: That’s because it has an extra thing.

behavior_patterns.condition: making predictions about which cup will make the egg float.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: language in the beginning of the discussion was decidedly 'everyday'
related_quotes: I think that this one because of the salt water, it will hold the egg up

behavior_patterns.condition: defending his explanation of mass differences.
related_quotes: It has extra salt and water.
